mapper.select: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS dimensionValue, COUNT(*) AS value FROM model_shop_order_record WHERE model_shop_id = #{modelShopId} AND type = 'PAY' AND create_time BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY dimensionValue ASC

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS dimensionValue, IFNULL(SUM(amount), 0) AS value FROM model_shop_order_record WHERE model_shop_id = #{modelShopId} AND type = 'PAY' AND create_time BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY dimensionValue ASC
